gbm_population_evidence.quote: Currently Only Enrolling Glioblastoma Patients at First Recurrence

When determining the maximum tolerated number of treatment cycles (MTC): patient has a histologically confirmed diagnosis of a grade 3 or 4 glioma (eg., glioblastoma, grade 4 astrocytoma, grade 3 astrocytoma, grade 3 oligodendroglioma).
When enrolling to Treatment Schedules 4 and 4a: patient has glioblastoma at first recurrence.

candidate_evidence.quote: NSC-CRAd-S-pk7 consists of neural stem cells that can target glioblastoma cells and carry a virus, which can kill cancer cells.

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: for the Treatment of Recurrent High-Grade Gliomas
Patient's high-grade glioma has recurred or progressed after prior treatment with brain radiation and temozolomide

role_evidence.quote: NSC-CRAd-S-pk7 consists of neural stem cells that can target glioblastoma cells and carry a virus, which can kill cancer cells.

agents.drug_class_hint: neural stem cell carrier loaded with conditionally replicating oncolytic adenovirus CRAd-S-pk7 (cell therapy + oncolytic virus)

biomarkers.biomarker_other: survivin and HSPG expression (IHC, pre/post treatment)

source_quote.quote: Changes in survivin expression by immunohistochemistry IHC in pre- and post-treatment tissue to see if there is a relationship with disease response.
Identify a molecular signature of vulnerability for predicting which glioma patients will benefit most from treatment with NSC-CRAd-S-pk7.

coder_notes: Only intervention is neural stem cell-delivered oncolytic adenovirus (cell therapy + oncolytic virus) -> excluded_intervention_type; no pharmacological candidate. Glioblastoma named in conditions and inclusion; earlier MTC part enrolled grade 3/4 glioma -> mixed_glioma_gbm_named. Grade 4 astrocytoma listed separately from glioblastoma but no IDH-wildtype requirement or WHO 2021 citation -> cns5_terminology unclear. Pharmacodynamic tissue sampling (survivin IHC, immune cell populations, CSF cytokines) is planned for the excluded agent, not a candidate, so tumour_pk/target_engagement coded no. Immune cell population/cytokine changes not recorded as molecular biomarkers. Temozolomide/bevacizumab mentioned only as prior therapy, not listed.
